# lspkit — The foundation for any language&#39;s tooling.

> lspkit is the language server toolkit: write your language analysis once in Rust, serve it over LSP and as an MCP server, and profile it with a CPU and memory profiler built into VS Code.

## Documentation

- [Crates.](http://localhost:8080/docs/crates/)

- [A small foundation.](http://localhost:8080/docs/)

- [Profiler.](http://localhost:8080/docs/profiler/)
